quotes.text: PRIMARY SOURCE RECORD DOSSIER — Municipal Board / Commission (2013-11-22)

turns.text: Rescue Department and with the onset of winter driving conditions and the holiday travel season fast approaching I wanted to cover a few items that we would recommend everybody carry in their vehicle safety kit first would be a tarp jumper cables collapsible shovel set of tow straps we have a headlamp we do recommend headlamps that way it leaves both hands-free to do whatever you need to do collapsible safety cone can of fix-a-flat small first aid kit 18 NBC fire extinguisher now as far as the storage of a fire extinguisher in your vehicle we do recommend that it either being a hard-sided case like this or mounted securely inside your trunk to prevent the fire extinguishers from flying around and getting damaged and what vehicle safety kit would be complete without a roll of duct tape as you can see in this small box we have those 11 items they're still in the even in their packaging there's still ample room for you to add quite a bit more items to customize your own vehicle safety kit now with that this is not a complete kit this is just the foundation upon which we recommend that you add additional items customize your kit for your location and you're expected driving addition additional items we would recommend for winter driving would be the addition of some snow chains water and non-perishable food food items that you can swap out every couple months the additional of addition of additional clothes items such as hats gloves boots etc for bad winter conditions now the vehicle safety kits are generally associated with with winter driving however we recommend that every vehicle carry one the entire year is a vehicle accident or a vehicle breakdown will leave you stranded anywhere at any time in poor or very dangerous conditions and even though your life may never depend on this vehicle safety kit these items would make a long wait on the side of the road much more comfortable and now now with that there's some additional considerations is always before you leave on a trip is to always ensure that your vehicle is in good operational condition get your vehicle service before leaving and always ensure that someone knows your travel

turns.text: rescue today we're reading the manufacturer's instructions on the proper installation of smoke detectors with the time change coming up in November we want to remind everyone this is the time to come in and check your smoke detector to make sure that it has proper batteries functioning normal and it's not more than 10 years old all smoke detectors that are more than 10 years old need to be replaced with the time change we change the batteries we want to make sure that we install the proper type of battery secure in the back once we secure the battery in we want to make sure and test the smoke detector for proper operation once we've done that we want to install it back in its location checking once more to make sure that the smoke detector still works in a home where the smoke detectors are all interconnected all the detectors should sound when you test one smoke detectors like these are independent station I'll need to be tested and have the batteries replaced independently once again with the time change will and remind everyone to make sure and change the batteries in your smoke detectors if you have any questions or need assistance please contact cheyenne fire administration at 6-3 7-6 3 11
